title: [Underground Temple, Cave In]
description: The unevenly packed earth crumbles with the faint trembling from below, causing clouds of dust to cover the air in an obscure haze.  Fissures form along the ground, the cracks filled with rocks of various sizes, obscure pieces of armor, and a large maul wedged between the dirt, the weapon prominently etched with an asp wrapped around the head.  Raggedly cut cloaks and backpacks lay scattered across the larger boulders, spilling out their contents beneath the sand and detritus.
